## SPX VIX-style term structure

This page uses Cboe SPX/SPXW end-of-day option quotes to calculate a VIX-style implied-volatility estimate for every usable expiration. The calculation follows the single-term structure of the Cboe VIX methodology, but these values are research estimates and are **not official Cboe indices**.

```{=html}
<div class="project-card spx-interactive-card">
  <div class="spx-toolbar">
    <p id="spx-vix-status">Loading SPX VIX-style term-structure history…</p>
    <label class="spx-horizon-label">
      Horizon
      <select id="spx-horizon">
        <option value="30">1M</option>
        <option value="90">3M</option>
        <option value="180">6M</option>
        <option value="365" selected>1Y</option>
        <option value="730">2Y</option>
        <option value="all">All</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div id="spx-vix-term-chart"></div>

  <div class="spx-slider-wrap">
    <input id="spx-date-slider"
           type="range"
           min="0"
           max="0"
           step="1"
           value="0"
           disabled
           aria-label="Select SPX term-structure trading date">
    <div class="spx-slider-labels">
      <span id="spx-start-date"></span>
      <strong id="spx-selected-date"></strong>
      <span id="spx-end-date"></span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/plotly.js-dist-min@4.1.0/plotly.min.js"></script>

<script>
(() => {
  const user = "siang-dai";
  const repo = "spx-vix-term-structure";
  const stamp = Date.now();
  const rawRoot = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${user}/${repo}/main`;
  const rawData = `${rawRoot}/data`;
  const rawOutput = `${rawRoot}/output`;

  const chart = document.getElementById("spx-vix-term-chart");
  const status = document.getElementById("spx-vix-status");
  const slider = document.getElementById("spx-date-slider");
  const horizon = document.getElementById("spx-horizon");
  const startLabel = document.getElementById("spx-start-date");
  const selectedLabel = document.getElementById("spx-selected-date");
  const endLabel = document.getElementById("spx-end-date");

  if (!chart || !status || !slider || !horizon || !startLabel || !selectedLabel || !endLabel) {
    console.error("SPX interactive DOM elements are missing.");
    return;
  }

  let allRows = [];
  let recentDates = [];

  function parseCsv(text) {
    const lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
    const headers = lines[0].split(",");
    return lines.slice(1).map(line => {
      const values = line.split(",");
      const row = Object.fromEntries(headers.map((header, i) => [header, values[i] ?? ""]));
      return {
        Date: (row.Date || "").trim(),
        Root: (row.Root || "").trim(),
        Settlement: (row.Settlement || "").trim(),
        Expiration_Date: (row.Expiration_Date || "").trim(),
        Days_to_Exp: Number(row.Days_to_Exp),
        Hours_to_Exp: Number(row.Hours_to_Exp),
        Forward: Number(row.Forward),
        K0: Number(row.K0),
        Risk_Free_Rate: Number(row.Risk_Free_Rate),
        VIX: Number(row.VIX),
        Options_Used: Number(row.Options_Used)
      };
    }).filter(row => row.Date && Number.isFinite(row.Days_to_Exp) && row.Days_to_Exp > 0 && Number.isFinite(row.VIX));
  }

  function isoDate(value) {
    return new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`);
  }

  function renderTermStructure(date) {
    const daily = allRows
      .filter(row => row.Date === date)
      .sort((a, b) => a.Days_to_Exp - b.Days_to_Exp);

    if (!daily.length) return;

    const selectedHorizon = horizon.value;
    const visibleDays = selectedHorizon === "all"
      ? Infinity
      : Number(selectedHorizon);
    const visible = daily.filter(row => row.Days_to_Exp <= visibleDays);
    const bodyColor = getComputedStyle(document.body).color;

    const trace = {
      type: "scatter",
      mode: "lines+markers",
      x: daily.map(row => row.Days_to_Exp),
      y: daily.map(row => row.VIX),
      text: daily.map(row => `${row.Root} ${row.Expiration_Date}`),
      customdata: daily.map(row => [
        row.Root,
        row.Settlement,
        row.Expiration_Date,
        row.Forward,
        row.K0,
        row.Risk_Free_Rate * 100,
        row.Options_Used,
        row.Hours_to_Exp
      ]),
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>%{text}</b>" +
        "<br>Settlement: %{customdata[1]}" +
        "<br>Days to expiration: %{x:.2f}" +
        "<br>Hours to expiration: %{customdata[7]:.1f}" +
        "<br>VIX-style IV: %{y:.2f}%" +
        "<br>Implied forward: %{customdata[3]:,.2f}" +
        "<br>K0: %{customdata[4]:,.2f}" +
        "<br>Risk-free rate: %{customdata[5]:.3f}%" +
        "<br>Options used: %{customdata[6]:.0f}" +
        "<extra></extra>",
      line: { width: 2.2 },
      marker: { size: 7 }
    };

    const maxVisible = selectedHorizon === "all"
      ? Math.max(...daily.map(row => row.Days_to_Exp))
      : Math.min(Number(selectedHorizon), Math.max(...daily.map(row => row.Days_to_Exp)));

    const layout = {
      title: {
        text: `SPX VIX-style Term Structure — ${date}`,
        x: 0.5,
        font: { size: 20 }
      },
      xaxis: {
        title: "Days to expiration",
        range: [0, Math.max(7, maxVisible * 1.03)],
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.18)",
        automargin: true
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: "Annualized implied volatility (%)",
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.18)",
        automargin: true
      },
      margin: { l: 75, r: 35, t: 60, b: 55 },
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font: { color: bodyColor, size: 13 },
      hovermode: "closest",
      showlegend: false,
      autosize: true
    };

    Plotly.react(chart, [trace], layout, {
      responsive: true,
      displaylogo: false,
      scrollZoom: true
    });

    selectedLabel.textContent = date;
    status.textContent =
      `Trading date: ${date} · ${daily.length} usable expirations` +
      (selectedHorizon === "all" ? " · showing all maturities." : ` · showing ≤ ${selectedHorizon} DTE (${visible.length} points).`);
  }

  function updateFromSlider() {
    const date = recentDates[Number(slider.value)];
    if (date) renderTermStructure(date);
  }

  fetch(`${rawData}/vix_term_structure_history.csv?t=${stamp}`)
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("SPX history unavailable");
      return response.text();
    })
    .then(text => {
      allRows = parseCsv(text);
      const allDates = [...new Set(allRows.map(row => row.Date))].sort();
      if (!allDates.length) throw new Error("No SPX history rows yet");

      const latestDate = allDates[allDates.length - 1];
      const cutoff = isoDate(latestDate);
      cutoff.setUTCDate(cutoff.getUTCDate() - 29);
      recentDates = allDates.filter(date => isoDate(date) >= cutoff);

      slider.min = "0";
      slider.max = String(recentDates.length - 1);
      slider.value = String(recentDates.length - 1);
      slider.disabled = false;
      startLabel.textContent = recentDates[0];
      endLabel.textContent = recentDates[recentDates.length - 1];

      slider.addEventListener("input", updateFromSlider);
      horizon.addEventListener("change", updateFromSlider);
      updateFromSlider();
    })
    .catch(error => {
      console.error(error);
      status.textContent = "Interactive history is not available yet; showing the latest static chart if present.";
      chart.innerHTML = `
        <img
          src="${rawOutput}/latest_term_structure.png?t=${stamp}"
          alt="Latest SPX VIX-style term structure"
          style="width:100%; max-width:1200px;"
        >
      `;
      slider.disabled = true;
    });
})();
</script>

The source data is the Cboe Proprietary Index Marking Prices file. The repository stores derived term-structure values rather than publishing the raw Cboe file. Risk-free rates are based on the U.S. Treasury CMT curve.
